title: Bootstrap: cheap model on orchestrator runtime feature audit
summary: 29 runtime features audited by Haiku through `orchestrate delegate` (contract passed, 50/50 evidence paths exist). Frontier spot-check found 2 over-claims (RT-09: per-node provider exclusion is failover, not a circuit breaker; RT-22: LRU trimming is not dependency-based invalidation), about 27/29 by spot check. Suitable for inventory with a spot-check; not yet for unreviewed status claims.
